استوئيا (form X)
# اُسْتُوئِيَا (ustūʔiyā) /us.tuː.ʔi.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
# اِسْتَوْئِيَا (istawʔiyā) /is.taw.ʔi.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَوْأَى (istawʔā) and اِسْتَوْءَى (istawʔā)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
